answer: Pay standing only for end-to-end service receipts: each epoch an identity is randomly matched to one stranger's real request — ferrying data across the harbor, say — and earns credit only when that stranger signs a receipt for correct, timely completion. One receipt per pair per epoch, and receipts from accounts funded by the same source do not count. Like cracking a walnut, a clone farm gets no shortcut: twenty names still need twenty distinct, older customers, each served separately under a willow-branching match tree that reshuffles every epoch.
